scares.description: Maxine stares into the kitchen as a gaunt old woman suddenly looms behind her.
Fleeing through the tall grass, Maxine is abruptly yanked back by Wayne.
A sudden cut to an unsettling doll face with a slight stinger.
As RJ pulls away, an old woman suddenly fills the windshield.
As Wayne peers through the wall's hole, a sudden, horrifying appendage violently bursts through.
As Lorraine triggers the lightbulb, a jarring cut slams to Wayne's head, spikes violently tearing free.
Lorraine flips the switch, and RJ's naked, cuffed corpse flashes into view.
Howard's face abruptly fills the screen.
Maxine's horrifying realization of her bedmate's identity triggers a guttural scream.
Bobby-Lynn throws open the door, only for a grotesque old woman to lunge directly at her.
The house owner suddenly slams Lorraine's hand into the doorframe as she picks the lock.
Just as Bobby-Lynn tries to help, the woman violently slaps her.
Bobby-Lynn is suddenly dragged into the dark lake.
Lorraine leaps out from behind the door, screaming.
Lorraine's dash from the house is violently cut short by a sudden, unseen shot from her flank.
Lorraine's sudden shriek makes Howard leap.
